cohort: The study included 186 participants: 59 COVID-19 children, 50 asymptomatic adult caregivers, 52 healthy children, and 25 healthy adults.
finding: The study found altered gut microbiota compositions, characterized by decreased Actinobacteria and Firmicutes and increased Bacteroidetes, Proteobacteria, and Verrucomicrobiota, along with perturbed microbial metabolic activities in both COVID-19 children and their asymptomatic caregivers infected with the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant compared to healthy controls.
